# Ethernet Media Access Controller (EMAC) — ADSP-SC59x EMAC Register Descriptions — Transmit Queue n ETS Status Register

<!-- source: 214_Ethernet_Media_Access_Controller_EMAC_ADSP-SC59x_EMAC_Regist.pdf | original pages 2504–2504 -->

## Transmit Queue n ETS Status Register

The EMAC\_TQ[n]\_ETS\_STAT register provides the average traffic transmitted in queue 1.

Figure 30-234: EMAC\_TQ[n]\_ETS\_STAT Register Diagram

<!-- image -->

Table 30-289: EMAC\_TQ[n]\_ETS\_STAT Register Fields

| Bit No. (Access)   | Bit Name   | Description/Enumeration                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|--------------------|------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 23:0 (R/NW)        | ABS        | Average Bits per Slot. The EMAC_TQ[n]_ETS_STAT.ABS field contains the average transmitted bits per slot. If AV operation is enabled, the EMAC_TQ[n]_ETS_STAT.ABS field is computed over the number of slots, programmed in EMAC_TQ[n]_ETS_CTL.SLC. The maxi- mum value of this field is 0x6_4000 in 100 Mbps, 0x3E_8000 in 1000 Mbps and 9C_4000 in 2500 Mbps mode respectively. When the DCB operation is enabled for queue, the EMAC_TQ[n]_ETS_STAT.ABS field is computed over every 10 million bit times slot (4 ms in 2500 Mbps; 10 ms in 1000 Mbps; 100 ms in 100 Mbps). The maximum value is 0x989680. |

# Ethernet Media Access Controller (EMAC) — ADSP-SC59x EMAC Register Descriptions — Transmit Queue n CBS HiCredit Register

<!-- source: 215_Ethernet_Media_Access_Controller_EMAC_ADSP-SC59x_EMAC_Regist.pdf | original pages 2505–2505 -->

## Transmit Queue n CBS HiCredit Register

The EMAC\_TQ[n]\_HICRDT register contains the HiCredit value required for the credit-based shaper algorithm for the queue.

Figure 30-235: EMAC\_TQ[n]\_HICRDT Register Diagram

<!-- image -->

Table 30-290: EMAC\_TQ[n]\_HICRDT Register Fields

| Bit No. (Access)   | Bit Name   | Description/Enumeration                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|--------------------|------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 28:0 (R/W)         | HC         | HiCredit Value. When the AV feature is enabled, the EMAC_TQ[n]_HICRDT.HC field contains the hiCredit value required for the credit-based shaper algorithm. This is the maximum value that can be accumulated in the credit parameter. It is specified in bits scaled by 1,024. The maximum value is maxInterferenceSize, that is, best-effort maximum packet size (16,384 bytes or 131,072 bits). The value to be specified is 131,072 * 1,024 = 134,217,728 or 0x0800_0000. |

# Ethernet Media Access Controller (EMAC) — ADSP-SC59x EMAC Register Descriptions — Transmit Queue n CBS LoCredit Register

<!-- source: 216_Ethernet_Media_Access_Controller_EMAC_ADSP-SC59x_EMAC_Regist.pdf | original pages 2506–2506 -->

## Transmit Queue n CBS LoCredit Register

The EMAC\_TQ[n]\_LOCRDT register contains the loCredit value required for the credit-based shaper algorithm for the queue.

Figure 30-236: EMAC\_TQ[n]\_LOCRDT Register Diagram

<!-- image -->

Table 30-291: EMAC\_TQ[n]\_LOCRDT Register Fields

| Bit No. (Access)   | Bit Name   | Description/Enumeration                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|--------------------|------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 28:0 (R/W)         | LC         | LoCredit Value. When the AV operation is enabled, the EMAC_TQ[n]_LOCRDT.LC field contains the loCredit value required for the credit-based shaper algorithm. This is the minimum value that can be accumulated in the credit parameter. It is specified in bits scaled by 1,024. The maximum value to be programmed corresponds to twice the maxFrame- Size transmitted from this queue. If the maxFrameSize is 8192 bytes, then (8192*2) * 8 * 1024 = 134,217,728 or 0x0800_0000. Because it is a negative value, the program- med value is the 2's complement of the value, that is, 0x1800_0000. |

The EMAC_TQ[n]_OPMODE.TQS field is read-write only if the number of Tx queues more than one; the reset value is 0x0 and indicates size of 256 bytes. # Ethernet Media Access Controller (EMAC) — ADSP-SC59x EMAC Register Descriptions — Transmit Queue n IdleSlopeCredit, Quantum or Weights Register

<!-- source: 218_Ethernet_Media_Access_Controller_EMAC_ADSP-SC59x_EMAC_Regist.pdf | original pages 2509–2510 -->

## Transmit Queue n IdleSlopeCredit, Quantum or Weights Register

The EMAC\_TQ[n]\_QTMWGT register provides the average traffic transmitted in queue 1.

Figure 30-238: EMAC\_TQ[n]\_QTMWGT Register Diagram

<!-- image -->

Table 30-293: EMAC\_TQ[n]\_QTMWGT Register Fields

| Bit No. (Access)   | Bit Name   | Description/Enumeration                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|--------------------|------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 20:0 (R/W)         | ISCQW      | IdleSlopeCredit, Quantum or Weights. When AV feature is enabled, the EMAC_TQ[n]_QTMWGT.ISCQW field contains the idleSlopeCredit value required for the credit-based shaper algorithm for queue 1. This is the rate of change of credit in bits per cycle (40 ns for 100 Mbps; 8 ns for 1000 Mbps; 3.2 ns for 2500 Mbps) when the credit is increasing. The software should pro- gram the EMAC_TQ[n]_QTMWGT.ISCQW field with computed credit in bits per cy- cle scaled by 1,024. The maximum value is portTransmitRate, that is, 0x2000 in 1000/2500 Mbps mode and 0x1000 in 100 Mbps mode. Bits[20:14] must be written to zero. Quantum When the DCB operation is enabled with DWRR algorithm for queue 1 traffic, the EMAC_TQ[n]_QTMWGT.ISCQW field field contains the quantum value in bytes to be added to credit during every queue scanning cycle. The maximum value is 0x1312D0 bytes. Weights When DCB operation is enabled with WFQalgorithm for queue 1 traffic, the EMAC_TQ[n]_QTMWGT.ISCQW field contains the weight for this queue. The max- imum value is 0x3FFF where weight of 0 indicates 100% bandwidth. Bits[20:14] must be written to zero. When DCB operation or generic queuing operation is enabled with WRR algorithm for queue 1 traffic, the EMAC_TQ[n]_QTMWGT.ISCQW field contains the weight for this queue. The maximum value is 0x64. Bits [20:7] must be written to zero. Note 1: In multiple queue configuration this field in respective per queue register must be programmed to some non-zero value when multiple queues are enabled or single queue other than Q0 is enabled. The EMAC_TQ[n]_QTMWGT.ISCQW field need not be programmed when only Q0 is enabled. In general, when WRR algorithm is se- lected a non-zero value must be programmed on both receive and transmit. In receive, the register is EMAC_MTL_OPMODE register. Note 2: For WFQalgorithm, higher the programmed weights lesser the bandwidth al- located for that transmit queue. The finish time is not a function of particular packet alone but it is as per the formula: (previous_finish_time of particular transmit queue + (weights*packet_size)) Note 3: The weights programmed do not correspond to the number of packets but the fraction of bandwidth or time allocated for particular queue with respect to totalBW or time. |

# Ethernet Media Access Controller (EMAC) — ADSP-SC59x EMAC Register Descriptions — Transmit Queue n SendSlopeCredit Register

<!-- source: 219_Ethernet_Media_Access_Controller_EMAC_ADSP-SC59x_EMAC_Regist.pdf | original pages 2511–2511 -->

## Transmit Queue n SendSlopeCredit Register

The EMAC\_TQ[n]\_SSCRDT register contains the sendSlope credit value required for the credit-based shaper algorithm for the queue.

Figure 30-239: EMAC\_TQ[n]\_SSCRDT Register Diagram

<!-- image -->

Table 30-294: EMAC\_TQ[n]\_SSCRDT Register Fields

| Bit No. (Access)   | Bit Name   | Description/Enumeration                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|--------------------|------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 13:0 (R/W)         | SSC        | SendSlopeCredit Value. When AV operation is enabled, the EMAC_TQ[n]_SSCRDT.SSC field contains the sendSlopeCredit value required for credit-based shaper algorithm for queue 1. This is the rate of change of credit in bits per cycle (40 ns, 8 ns and 3.2 ns for 100 Mbps, 1000 Mbps and 2500 Mbps respectively) when the credit is decreasing. The software should program this field with computed credit in bits per cycle scaled by 1,024. The maximum value is portTransmitRate, that is, 0x2000 in 1000/2500 Mbps mode and 0x1000 in 100 Mbps mode. The EMAC_TQ[n]_SSCRDT.SSC field should be programmed with absolute sendSlopeCredit value. The credit-based shaper logic subtracts it from the accumulated credit when channel 1 is selected for transmis- sion. |

# Ethernet Media Access Controller (EMAC) — ADSP-SC59x EMAC Register Descriptions — Receive Jabber Error Packets Counter Register

<!-- source: 260_Ethernet_Media_Access_Controller_EMAC_ADSP-SC59x_EMAC_Regist.pdf | original pages 2552–2552 -->

## Receive Jabber Error Packets Counter Register

The EMAC\_RX\_JBERR\_PCNT register provides the number of giant packets received by the EMAC module with length (including CRC) greater than 1,518 bytes (1,522 bytes for VLAN tagged) and with CRC error. When jumbo packet mode is enabled (EMAC\_MAC\_CFG.JE = 1), packets of length greater than 9,018 bytes (9,022 bytes for VLAN tagged) are considered as giant packets.

Figure 30-280: EMAC\_RX\_JBERR\_PCNT Register Diagram

<!-- image -->

Table 30-335: EMAC\_RX\_JBERR\_PCNT Register Fields

| Bit No. (Access)   | Bit Name   | Description/Enumeration                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|--------------------|------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 15:0 (R/NW)        | RXJABERR   | Rx Jabber Error Packets. The EMAC_RX_JBERR_PCNT.RXJABERR field indicates the number of giant packets received with length (including CRC) greater than 1,518 bytes (1,522 bytes for VLAN tagged) and with CRC error. If jumbo packet mode is enabled (EMAC_MAC_CFG.JE = 1), packets of length greater than 9,018 bytes (9,022 bytes for VLAN tagged) are considered as giant packets. |

| 31:0 (R/NW)        | RXWDGERR   | Rx Watchdog Error Packets. The EMAC_RX_WDTERR_PCNT.RXWDGERR field indicates the number of packets received with error because of watchdog timeout error (packets with a data load larger than 2,048 bytes (when EMAC_MAC_CFG MAC.JE = 0 and EMAC_MAC_CFG MAC.WD = 0), 10,240 bytes (when EMAC_MAC_CFG MAC.JE = 1 and EMAC_MAC_CFG MAC.WD = 0), 16,384 bytes (when EMAC_MAC_CFG MAC.WD = 1) or the value programmed in the EMAC_WDT_TMOUT register). |
